description: Impeccable design detector: immediate-tier checks after Edit/Write on UI files, full-rule deep pass on Stop.

hooks.command: engine="$HOME/.impeccable/vaultdex/engine-0.1.11/impeccable"; case "${OSTYPE:-}" in msys*|cygwin*) engine="$engine.exe";; esac; if [ -x "$engine" ]; then "$engine" hook; fi
engine="$HOME/.impeccable/vaultdex/engine-0.1.11/impeccable"; case "${OSTYPE:-}" in msys*|cygwin*) engine="$engine.exe";; esac; if [ -x "$engine" ]; then "$engine" hook; fi

dir=${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}
root=$(git -C "$dir" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)
[ -n "$root" ] || { [ -d "$dir/.vendor/workflow-kit" ] && printf '%s\n' 'Workflow Kit not checked: git did not find the project repository (is git on PATH?). From the project root run git submodule update --init .vendor/workflow-kit'; exit 0; }
set -- $(git -C "$root" ls-files -s -- .vendor/workflow-kit 2>/dev/null)
[ "$1" = 160000 ] || exit 0
pin=$2
kit="$root/.vendor/workflow-kit"
ok() { [ "$(git -C "$kit" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null)" = "$pin" ] && [ -f "$kit/AGENT_RULES.md" ]; }
ok && exit 0
if [ -e "$kit/.git" ] && { [ -n "$(git -C "$kit" status --porcelain --ignored --untracked-files=all 2>/dev/null)" ] || [ -n "$(git -C "$kit" rev-list -n 1 HEAD --not --remotes 2>/dev/null)" ]; }; then printf '%s\n' 'Workflow Kit is not at the commit this project pins, but it has local changes or unpublished commits, so it was not updated: resolve them, then from the project root run git submodule update --init .vendor/workflow-kit'; exit 0; fi
GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_ASKPASS=true SSH_ASKPASS=true git -C "$root" -c credential.interactive=false -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null submodule update --init --checkout .vendor/workflow-kit >/dev/null 2>&1
ok || printf '%s\n' 'Workflow Kit missing, incomplete or not at the commit this project pins: from the project root run git submodule update --init .vendor/workflow-kit (still missing: git -C .vendor/workflow-kit checkout -- AGENT_RULES.md)'

launcher="$HOME/.ponytail/vaultdex/4.10.3-1/launch.sh"; if [ -f "$launcher" ]; then /bin/sh "$launcher" activate claude; else printf '%s\n' 'Ponytail hooks missing: run git submodule update --init --recursive .vendor/workflow-kit, then node .vendor/workflow-kit/scripts/install-ponytail-hooks.mjs and trust the hooks.'; fi

engine="$HOME/.impeccable/vaultdex/engine-0.1.11/impeccable"; case "${OSTYPE:-}" in msys*|cygwin*) engine="$engine.exe";; esac; if [ ! -x "$engine" ]; then printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage":"Impeccable hooks missing, UI checks are off: run git submodule update --init --recursive .vendor/workflow-kit, then node .vendor/workflow-kit/scripts/install-impeccable-hooks.mjs and trust the hooks.","hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"Impeccable hooks missing, UI checks are off: run git submodule update --init --recursive .vendor/workflow-kit, then node .vendor/workflow-kit/scripts/install-impeccable-hooks.mjs and trust the hooks."}}'; fi

launcher="$HOME/.ponytail/vaultdex/4.10.3-1/launch.sh"; if [ -f "$launcher" ]; then /bin/sh "$launcher" activate claude continue; else printf '%s\n' 'Ponytail hooks missing: run git submodule update --init --recursive .vendor/workflow-kit, then node .vendor/workflow-kit/scripts/install-ponytail-hooks.mjs and trust the hooks.'; fi

GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_ASKPASS=true SSH_ASKPASS=true git -C "$root" -c credential.interactive=false -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null submodule update --init --checkout .vendor/workflow-kit >/dev/null 2>&1
